sources.snippet: The most complete on-device sentiment toolkit in the R/Python ecosystem. It ships hate-speech / mixed / style flags, intent-based profiles, an interactive sentiment map, and opt-in transformer backends for when you want maximum accuracy. The default model, on-device e5-base, matches the paid OpenAI embedding (text-embedding-3-small) on our benchmarks: that quality, free, across ~100 languages ...
